name: the-app-and-python-agree-on-what-the-phone-covers
breaks: the app thinks Instagram covers the bottom 100px of a frame while the generators are held to 160, so the preview overlay draws the covered band 60px lower than it is and reports a template as clear when its wordmark is under Instagram's caption. That is worse than drawing no overlay at all, because the reassuring answer is the wrong one (#753, #758)
